description: Change a watch's maximum price, minimum discount and/or accepted conditions, keeping its watch_id, feed URL, webhook and history. Send only what changes; null removes the price cap or the discount floor. Returns the watch as check_watch does, with live_matches under the new terms: alert only on unseen ids, and restart any cursor scan. A new product, scope, brand or attribute needs a new watch.

conditions.description: The complete new set of accepted conditions; it replaces the old set.

max_price_cents.description: New price ceiling in cents (35000 = $350). null removes the ceiling.

min_discount_pct.description: New minimum discount percentage. null or 0 removes it.

name: update_watch
title: Edit a watch
